faq.title: Common questions
faq.match.a: We compare the student's level, curriculum, goals, subject or counseling focus, destination, where your family lives, preferred format, urgency and profile fit.
faq.gulf.a: Families in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman. Online tutors list the Gulf countries they teach, and in-person tutors show their city. Use Where to see who serves you.
faq.parents.a: Yes. Parent participation is especially useful for counseling, destination planning and younger students.
faq.destination.q: Can I choose a counselor who studied in our destination country?
faq.destination.a: You can request that preference. Profiles show relevant study, work or advising experience when available.
faq.advice.q: Is this admissions or immigration advice?
faq.advice.a: No. Counseling sessions are educational guidance only and do not replace official admissions, visa, legal or immigration advice.
faq.online.a: Yes. Many profiles teach online across the Gulf, and some also meet in person in their own city. Choose "Online, anywhere in the Gulf" under Where to see online tutors.
faq.request.q: How do I request a tutor introduction?
faq.request.a: Use Show matches, the Request an introduction button on a profile, or the contact form. Each opens a prefilled email you can review before sending.
